directive.quote: For valuable work, inspect the actual behavior and integrate the final correct implementation into the default branch using ordinary commits.

preserve: Current shared UI components and explicit allowed boolean; historical decisions never grant permission.
allowed_deltas: Retain decision history and consumed usage from the A1 branch through the current owner feeds and panel.
banned_substitutions: No fabricated owner approval or implicit permission from history.

baseline.note: Existing source behavior comparison; no external visual reference or appearance change.

proof.note: Source integration and local component checks only; no live appearance claim.
